lesson_title: From Coal to Your Light Switch
hook_text: The light above your head started as a lump of coal underground. Here is its journey.
clip_script: Kriel, Mpumalanga. Coal rides a conveyor belt into a power station. Crushed to powder, it burns in a giant boiler. Water boils into steam. Steam spins a turbine like a giant fan. The turbine turns a generator: magnets and copper coils, and out comes electricity. Up onto the pylons, across the country, down through transformers, into your meter, along the wires to your switch. Click. And back again, because it is a circuit.
visual_style: Whiteboard road map from mine to power station to pylons to house, with the energy chain labelled at each stop.
mood: Epic journey, like following a river from its source to the sea.
pacing: Fast power station sequence, then a road trip along the lines, ending with a click.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find your home's meter and distribution board with an adult.
